references.text: Describes the tithe to be given to the Levite, the foreigner, the fatherless, and the widow every third year, the same groups mentioned in 26:13.
Refers to the prohibition against eating the tithe within the gates and the command to share with the Levite, relating to the cleansing of the holy from the house.
Gives detailed instructions about the tithe and care for the Levite, which is the background for the declaration in 26:13.
Describes the Levites' right to the tithe as their inheritance, confirmed by the declaration of having given to the Levite.
Commands care for the foreigner, the fatherless, and the widow at harvest time, the same social groups mentioned in 26:13.
Emphasizes the importance of not turning to the right or to the left from God's commands, parallel to 'I have not transgressed your commandments'.
The psalmist declares that he has not forgotten God's statutes, the same expression as 'I have not forgotten' in 26:13.
The psalmist declares that he has not forgotten God's commands, parallel to the declaration of not having forgotten.
